title.narrative: Rural Connectivity Improvement Project

description.narrative: The RCIP will improve the road network connecting the rural population to agriculture value chain development zones in Bangladesh. The project was prepared under the project design advance. Investments will be made to (i) upgrade about 1,700 kilometers of rural roads to all-weather standards in 34 districts located in five divisions; (ii) improve the capacity of the rural infrastructure agency to address institutional constraints relating to rural road development; and (iii) finance enhancements to the national rural road master plan to enable the selection of priority rural roads for improvement using a geographic information system covering the entire country.

Status of Implementation Progress: Contracts awarded for 2,617.93 km roads. Out of these, 1,823.50 km roads have already been substantially improved to all weather standards. Works ongoing for the other 794.44 km roads.
A draft manual has been prepared by the consultant recruited under TA 9632.
Two workshops on Awareness Enhancement of Road Users on Road Safety, Human Trafficking and Prevention of Sexually Transmitted Infections conducted in the Districts of Chapai Nawabganj and Rangpur. A total of 40 numbers of participants were attended of which 13 were Women.
Total of 132 nos. contracts been awarded to the respective contractors. Written guidance provided to ensure all bidding documents included gender related national core labor standard clause.
Nine number of orientation and skills development workshops on RCIP procedures have been conducted between November 2021 to June 2022 at regional level where total 810 participants attended from which 63 were women (7.78%).
Two workshops on 'Skill Enhancement of Women Workers on Road Construction and Maintenance" have been conducted in Brahmanbaria and Gopalganj Districts. A total of 40 female workers attended the training courses.
Training plan was planned for 16 courses. Training course outline including objectives, contents, method, materials and training budgets have been prepared for all the courses and conducted in time.
Seven School Based Road Safety Awareness Campaign have been conducted in four different Government Primary Schools. These campaigns had been executed in Chattogram, Brahmanbaria, Bogura Madaripur, Gopalganj and Rajshahi Districts. More than 1,636 students, teachers, SMC members, LGIs and Civil Society representatives participated in the campaigns.
The Capacity Development Consultant submitted Final Inception Report. Software Requirement Specification (SRS), Mobile App and Web Based RSDMS have been Finalized. Software Design Document (SDD) is being continuously updated. Now Beta version of the system is ready. Already training has been provided to the Enumerators. Currently Pilot Survey is ongoing in District level. As of today, 6,000 road survey have been completed.
TA 9632: 91% disbursed as of 01 Jul 2025
